concerns.text: T101 requires 'execute it on the fitted full model from the real analysis' and its verification asserts the PNGs exist 'after execution on the real model fit', but the only task that produces the real end-to-end model fit is T103, which is ordered AFTER T101. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency: either T101 must be moved after T103 (or made to run the regression itself as an explicit prerequisite step), or T103 split so the real fit precedes T101.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Execution order note — T104 [P] vs T105 [P]
concerns.text: T104 [P] writes new test files under code/tests/unit/ while T105 [P] 'applies black formatting to all files under code/' and requires zero flake8 errors. If run truly in parallel, T105's lint gate can fail on or reformat T104's in-flight files. Mark T105 as depending on T104 (or scope T105's [P] to source files only) so the parallel tags are safe.

T107 is listed as parallelizable with T104/T105, which is fine, but the note omits that T107 also implicitly requires T101–T103 (it documents artifacts like model_residuals.png, permutation_results.csv, sensitivity_summary.csv that those tasks produce). State 'T107 requires T101–T103' explicitly to avoid a documentation task running before its subject artifacts exist.
